title: Ros2ControlStatus
description: A controller or hardware component crossing into or out of the ros2_control `active` lifecycle state, derived from the controller manager's `~/activity` topic: one Record when it starts, one when it ends

seq.description: Monotonically increasing number of this Record, across every controller and hardware component, so a dropped Record is detectable rather than silently shortening an outage

component_type.description: Whether 'component' names a controller or a hardware component

component.description: Reporting controller or hardware component name

event.description: 'start' when the component entered 'active', 'end' when it left 'active'

previous_state_duration_s.description: Seconds 'from_state' had been held: on a start Record, how long the component had been out of 'active' before this; on an end Record, how long it had been 'active'

open.description: true on a start Record, false on an end Record -- a component still active when collection stops simply never gets a matching end Record, so it cannot be averaged as a zero
